notes.title: New Patch is live!
notes.content:
[h1]We have been hard at work to deliver this in time for the holidays![/h1]

[h2][b]Improvements [/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Volumes shown on beer bottle labels will now show in Imperial, if that is the selected measurement system 
[*] Various audio SFX added   
[*] Improvements to game performance  
[*] Targeted improvements to time skip on late game saves 
[/list]

[b][h2]Bug Fixes [/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue during the tutorial where input shortcuts in the Brewer’s Quarterly were not properly disabled 
[*] Fixed an issue where the Recipe Creator could close without saving after editing certain fields  
[*] Fixed an issue where keyword tooltip detection would not update properly when changing language 
[*] Fixed an issue where the season could be advanced without opening the latest issue of Brewer’s Quarterly 
[*] Fixed an issue where the bonus requirement for “The Joy of Brewing” job were not showing as completed when they should 
[*] Fixed an issue where placing some furniture closely together could result in being unable to move the furniture afterwards 
[*] Fixed an issue in the Recipe Creator where some values could not be entered manually 
[*] Fixed an issue preventing interacting with a pump if you had an unstowed item in your hand 
[*] Fixed camera framing in the tasting sequence for some of the larger glasses and bottles 
[*] Fixed various issues with the label maker, such as some settings not working as they should 
[*] Fixed an issue where the medium Cornelius Keg could have the wrong name and volume when reloading a save 
[*] “Add to Cart” will now always show on the Pinned Recipe tab in the Catalogue 
[*] Fixed an issue where the x-ray display could overlap with other HUD elements 
[*] Fixed an issue where previously placed posters were difficult to select after loading a save game 
[*] The tooltip delay setting will no longer sometimes result in multiple tooltips being displayed at once 
[*] Fixed various localisation issues 
[*] Bags of sugar and herbs & spices will now display the correct units of measurement when pouring 
[*] Picnic cooler will now clean properly 
[*] “Next: Partner” will no longer be shown as the next reputation level with a brewery when you’re already at max reputation 
[*] Fixed issue where save game time stamps didn't correctly match the time zone 
[*] The tops of electric kettles no longer fade out when setting temperature 
[*] Fixed an issue where the colour of wort could be visually incorrect after loading a previous save 
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when repeatedly filling a brew pot with water from the sink tap 
[*] Fixed issue where Catalogue shortcut could become disabled during the tutorial 
[*] Fixed issue where connecting a pump to the sink tap could cause the tap to stop working 
[*] Fixed an issue where the name of interactable items would not show. 
[*] Fixed some issues with the display of inventory amounts on various screens 
[*] Fixed an issue where rounding would cause apparent discrepancies in style matches 
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur on the competition screen 
[/list]

As always, if you have any issues, let us know via the [url=https://form.asana.com/?k=ioS-gR2ztiPN3EQkwP6RXA&d=7278281010359] bug form [/url] which is [b][i]now fixed finally[/i][/b]

notes.title: A big thank you to our Brewmaster: Beer Brewing Simulator community 🍻
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40208531/61847dba1de9ddb25a9623cf3201bc79e128134b.png[/img]

[h2]👋🏻 Hi Brewers Club! 🍁[/h2]
[h3]Welcome to the November issue of the Brewers club with your latest update on Brewmaster🍻[/h3]
Make sure you are [url=https://aurochdigital.us7.list-manage.com/subscribe?id=2491c97e85&u=80f9f24ab53812fcb7ca58b1c]subscribed to our Brewers Club Newsletter[/url] to get these updates direct to your inbox.

First up, let's hear from the devs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40208531/002cd02053e520bda291354eb9dab0103ce06d38.png[/img]

Hey Brewers!

First of all we’d like to extend a sincere thank you to everyone who has played and enjoyed Brewmaster (and even if you didn’t, your thoughts help us make better games). We know it hasn’t been all smooth sailing, and we’re incredibly grateful for your patience whilst we fix those pesky bugs. 

Our amazing community team has been showing us how you’ve all been interacting with the features of the game and it’s incredible to see our creations used in ways we didn’t think of, and in cases where it results in some buggy behaviour; chatting with the design and code team leads to get fixes pushed through asap.  

But what else has been going on? Well, we released on consoles! And to celebrate that launch we added a whole host of game posters from our fellow indie developer friends to the game. We hope you enjoy showing off your favourites!  

We’ve also been hard at work fixing all manner of bugs, and most importantly getting those fixes out to our console players as well. Another patch is on the horizon! We can’t say for sure when it will be live, but we’re working on it.  

A short but sweet update this month Brewers, but hopefully as the team winds down and moves to other exciting projects you’ll continue to love Brewmaster and share your creations with us!  

Thank you all for your support!  💝

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40208531/793c53e8a16b872736260e92ed51e760f020446a.png[/img]
[h2]Brewmaster is now available on all major platforms! 🥳[/h2]

In case you missed it, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1569200/Brewmaster_Beer_Brewing_Simulator/]PC[/url], [url=https://www.xbox.com/en-gb/games/store/brewmaster-beer-brewing-simulator/9n4b8bm1j3dt]Xbox[/url], [url=https://www.nintendo.co.uk/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/Brewmaster-Beer-Brewing-Simulator-2268710.html]Nintendo[/url] and [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/product/EP2520-PPSA03868_00-BREWMASTERAUROCH]PlayStation[/url] brewers are now all able to meet Jeff and the rest of the team.

Thank you all so much to everyone who's followed our journey from announce and beyond, and a big welcome to our newest members of the community too! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40208531/e924ada45b20c2b2e99fdf30f2d926fe927dda21.png[/img]
[h2]Thank you for the reviews so far! ⭐[/h2]

We want to give another massive thank you to our PC players for reviewing the game on Steam, we really appreciate it! And the two of you who reviewed on Xbox - we see you! 👀

We have over 550 reviews, which is amazing! As a smaller game developer we can’t stress how much they mean to us and how important they are. 

[url=https://www.aurochdigital.com/blog/2018/11/9/how-and-why-to-review-on-steam]Click here to learn more[/url] about why reviews are important and to get [url=https://www.aurochdigital.com/blog/2018/11/9/how-and-why-to-review-on-steam]more information on how to leave a review[/url].  

For our console players who've been able to play Brewmaster for a month now, our blog post explains how to do it for Xbox, and PlayStation.

And if you've played Brewmaster on PC, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1569200/Brewmaster_Beer_Brewing_Simulator/]spill your thoughts[/url], we'd love to hear what you think about Brewmaster!

notes.title: Patch Notes: v1.0.6.5 (27th Oct 2022)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40208531/61847dba1de9ddb25a9623cf3201bc79e128134b.png[/img]
[h2]Greetings Brewers! 🍻 [/h2]
Our latest patch features a crate-full of bug fixes and improvements, as well as some eye-catching game posters to brighten up your workshops as part of our Indie Celebration Content Update. Enjoy!   

[h3]Improvements [/h3]
[list][*] [b]Indie Celebration Content Update:[/b] added a selection of game posters that can be bought from the Catalogue (more will become available at each Mastery level in Brewmaster mode)  
[*] Added various new brewing hints 
[*] Resetting to default settings in options screens will now show a confirmation message before applying the change 
[*] Improved fade out of liquid puddles 
[*] Improved late game performance 
[*] Improved performance when looking at shelves with an item in hand 
[*] Improved translations in various languages [/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where pumps would transfer solid ingredients, such as grains. You can now safely use pumps when transferring wort from your mash tuns 
[*] Recipes for Irish Red Ale, California Common, and Kellerbier will no longer ask players to ferment and condition at below room temperature 
[*] The Tooltip Delay setting in options will now correctly affect tooltips 
[*] Fixed an issue where Brewing Hints were set to “Advanced” by default, instead of “All Tips” 
[*] Fixed issue where containers could float in a spooky way when loading a save in which containers were placed on heat mats 
[*] Fixed an issue where the bottom part of electric kettles would vanish on loading a previous save 
[*] Electric kettles will now highlight properly when looked at 
[*] Fixed an issue where the tutorial would no longer display if loading from a Free Play game into a previous Brewmaster game where the tutorial was active 
[*] Fixed issue where incorrect input glyphs could show when switching to a mouse and keyboard 
[*] Fixed issue where the shortcut input for various confirm buttons wasn’t working 
[*] Fixed various issues with Brew Kettles, including not being able to place an immersion coil in the small Brew Kettle and their lids on/off state not saving properly 
[*] Fixed an issue where cosmetic items couldn’t be placed on a wall near the front door 
[*] Fixed an issue where picking up a container with multiple tubes attached when your inventory is already full could result in blocking equipping other items 
[*] The industrial coffee table (glass) and industrial crate should now be moveable in build mode 
[*] Fixed an issue where Imperial measurements would show oz instead of lb in recipes 
[*] Fixed various issues when using Imperial measurements in the Recipe Creator 
[*] Fixed issue where HUD warning messages could be cut off in various languages 
[*] Fixed some visual issues with overflowing liquid in various containers 
[*] Fixed various instances of unlocalised or incorrect text 
[*] Fixed various instances of overflowing text in different languages 
[*] Fixed incorrect translation for “To Boldy Gose” job requirement in Traditional Chinese 
[*] Fixed an issue where the “countdown” confirmation sometimes wouldn't count down correctly when changing display settings 
[*] Fixed an issue where the style matching tooltip in the tasting sequence was incorrectly rounding up some values (e.g. showing 5.9% ABV as 6.0%) 
[*] Fixed an issue where articles would be missing or not display entirely in the Brewpedia at certain UI scales 
[*] Fixed issue where it was possible to brew a beer with over 100% ABV, which is arguably a bit too strong [/list]
As always, the team would like to give a huge hearty THANK YOU to all those who have left reviews here on Steam and helped spread the word about Brewmaster. Your support means the world to us.  And as always if you have any questions do let us know here on Steam, [url=http://discord.gg/AurochDigital]or over on our Discord[/url]. Have a brewtiful day!

notes.title: Patch Notes: v 1.0.5.0 (14th October 2022)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40208531/61847dba1de9ddb25a9623cf3201bc79e128134b.png[/img]
[h2]Greetings Brewers! 🍻 [/h2]
Another patch overflowing with fixes and improvements. A huge thanks to all the players who have let us know about the issues and given their feedback, and to all those who have left reviews. Your support is massively appreciated by the team. 

[h3]Improvements [/h3]
[list][*] Added Brewing Tips settings to the options menu. These tips can now be turned off, set to advanced only, and also reset  
[*] Added a warning when trying to place containers that are too large in the sink 
[*] All Brewpedia articles are now available from the start in Free Play mode; this will have no effect on Brewmaster mode, where articles need to be unlocked as before 
[*] Improved several recipe images to be visually closer to the beer style 
[/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where the “Brewmaster” achievement didn’t unlock 
[*] Fixed issue where the “Error Detected” job couldn’t be completed 
[*] Fixed an issue where the bonus objective of “Hopping Mad” couldn’t be completed 
[*] Fixed an issue where “Off” flavours were sometimes being counted as a flavour for job requirements when they shouldn’t 
[*] Fixed issue where the job “Free Spirit” could not be completed (ABV is no longer a critical stat for Belgian-Style Witbier) 
[*] Fixed an issue where some Local Brewery unlock achievements were unlocking at the wrong time 
[*] Added an improved fix for Kristoff’s final story stage, which involves completing a Very Difficult Ascent job. This should now work retroactively for players who have already completed a valid job. Note that if the objective doesn’t immediately complete, try one of the following: brew a new beer (any will do); open the delivery box; or advance to next season 
[*] Numerous text fixes in all languages 
[*] Fixed missing Electric Kettle article page in French language 
[*] Fixed missing article page in Spanish  
[*] Fixed issue where an empty X-ray display could be seen for finished beers (X-ray mode should not be available for finished beers) 
[*] Fixed an issue where pounds (lb) would be displayed as ounces (oz) when using Imperial measurements 
[*] Fixed a rounding issue when retrieving ingredient weights when using Imperial measurements, which meant that the same value was incorrectly shown when changing the amount 
[*] The recipe for English-Style Mild now has the correct image 
[*] Fixed issue where connecting pumps in a certain way would result in the pump not working 
[*] Fixed a crash when loading a save game after changing language 
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when naming a player-created recipe  
[*] Oak barrels are now correctly positioned when placed in the keg racks 
[*] Fixed an issue where conditioning containers couldn’t be placed in the keg rack once they were removed 
[*] Fixed an issue where binding the left arrow as a secondary input for move left would result in it behaving as move right  
[*] Fixed issue where bottle types were incorrectly aligned in the packaging sequence 
[*] Fixed issue where the game could fail to launch due to a conflict with VR software 
[*] Fixed an issue where the spacebar shortcut failed to work on various dialogue boxes 
[*] Fixed an issue where the controller cursor could become misaligned with the on-screen UI 
[*] Fixed an issue where CO2 tanks would disappear when placing a keg on a heating mat 
[*] Fixed an issue where it was possible to retrieve an infinite number of barrels of the same beer from the cellar 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Swap Menu wasn’t working in Free Play Mode when in Build Mode 
[/list]As always, [b]a massive thank you[/b] to everyone for your reviews here on Steam and spreading the word about the game with your friends - as a small team, we really appreciate your support! And as always if you have any questions do let us know here on Steam, [url=http://discord.gg/AurochDigital]or over on our Discord[/url]. Have a brewtiful day!

notes.title: Patch Notes: v.1.0.4.7 (7th October 2022)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40208531/61847dba1de9ddb25a9623cf3201bc79e128134b.png[/img]

[h3]Hello everyone, [/h3]
The [b]first major Patch for Brewmaster brings with it fixes for the most-reported issues we’ve received[/b], as well as a handful of small but impactful improvement requests. A few of the bigger highlights are; 
[list]
[*] Counterflow chillers and wort plate chillers no longer remove bitterness (IBU), flavours, or other properties from wort 
[*] Fixes for a variety of situations that would block progress in Brewmaster Mode 
[*] Fixes for a variety of Steam Achievements 
[*] Fixed issue where gaining reputation levels with Wild Vale didn't grant the appropriate rewards or unlock the commercial slot. This will work retroactively: keep an eye out for a delivery box with any previous rewards you weren't given at the time!
[/list]
Our full patch list is below, 
[h3][u]Improvements[/u] [/h3]
[list]
[*] Frame rate improvements in certain areas 
[*] All UI Screens have had safe zone scaling added to them 
[*] Improved beer framing at end of Tasting Sequence 
[*] Tweaks to fading large  objects when camera clips through them 
[*] Currency and brewing status text now easier to see 
[*] Implemented a fade-up to  improve level transitions 
[*] Players can now move the calendars in the workshop (in build mode) 
[/list]
[h3][u]Bug Fixes[/u] [/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where Kristoff's final story stage wasn't completing properly. Note: players will have to complete a new "very difficult" Ascent job to complete this stage; we're currently working on a retroactive fix for those who have already completed an applicable job, but this isn't ready yet 
[*] Counterflow chillers and wort plate chillers no longer remove bitterness (IBU), flavours, or other properties from wort 
[*] Fixed multiple instances of broken text in Brewpedia, especially in German language 
[*] Two spotlights in the kitchen (above the counters) now cast light onto walls 
[*] Fixed issue where yeast sometimes incorrectly had a retrieve amount menu 
[*] The achievement "First!" Now unlocks; other competition-related achievements should also now work as intended 
[*] Fixed an issue where temperature control readout/settings failed to work in some situations 
[*] Prompt to place the finished beer container in the Keg Rack no longer displayed when hovering the cursor on the rack in the drawing room 
[*] Fermentation krausen no longer vanishes instantly when heated up 
[*] Visual improvements to tubes attached to carboys 
[*] No longer able to place large items over the edges of coffee tables and foot stalls 
[*] Fixed a visual issue with the highlight for fermentation container airlocks  
[*] Lace effect on containers now appears less dim 
[*] Corn Sugar now displays sugar, not grains, when pouring 
[*] Inappropriate shadow no longer visible for the beer bottle's cap when placed on the table in the tasting room 
[*] 3kg malt extract can now appears full when full 
[*] Mesh bags placed in containers now attach correctly. 
[*] Battered pot overflow visuals fixed 
[*] Wort transfer no longer disrupted and failing to complete when skipping days using calendar 
[*] Packaged beer contents no longer disappear after loading autosave after submitting to tasting sequence 
[*] Staff credits formatted correctly 
[*] Swap inventory option now correctly highlights furniture 
[*] UI prompts no longer overlapping when scaling set to 100% 
[*] Fix for an issue where the tutorial stage involving hops could break 
[*] Achievements for unlocking breweries are now received when brewery is unlocked, not before 
[*] Fixed an issue where the tutorial stage sometimes failed to update  after adding water or malt extract when using Imperial measurements  
[*] Dial thermometers on containers should now correctly display the temperature 
[*] Fixed some instances of tooltips being cut off 
[*] Individual performance settings now switch to very high when using very high graphics preset 
[*] Now able to use  shortcut inputs on packaging screen to progress 
[*] Can now place Container on Hob when Tube is very close 
[*] Missing text in key bindings options added 
[*] Item list scrolls in the delivery package with the R joystick movement on controller 
[*] Place item no longer shown when holding a burner looking at another burner 
[*] Malt extract cans now have the correct labels 
[*] Now able to place fermentation and conditioning containers on heat mats (added as part of previous hotfix) 
[*] Cloud Saves now enabled (added as part of previous hotfix) 
[/list]
As always, [b]a massive thank you[/b] to everyone for your reviews here on Steam and spreading the word about the game with your friends - as a small team, we really appreciate your support! And as always if you have any questions do let us know here on Steam, [url=http://discord.gg/AurochDigital]or over on our Discord[/url].

 [h2]🍻 We're really hoppy to share our latest update! 🍻[/h2]

🎮 But before that, you lovely folks had the opportunity to get hands on with the Brewmaster demo throughout Next Fest and beyond, and we hope you enjoyed every moment of it. We received a lot of really valuable feedback from our community, and have been putting our heads down working on improving the game.  

📝 Our design team have written up a full tutorial and a whole host of contextual hints/tips to fully introduce future Brewmasters to the intricacies of brewing the perfect beer. We’ve also gone back to the drawing board on a few objects we’ve received some feedback on; namely the sink and the electric brew kettle. Your feedback has really helped us redesign these to be intuitive to players, not just us folks making the game. And has really highlighted to the team that we don’t always know best!  

🔢 Some of our code team have been hard at work with our final big feature. We can’t say too much, but you should definitely look forward to it. Meanwhile, other members of our code team have been hard at work overhauling pouring and brew visuals to improve performance across the board. You probably won't notice these, as we’ve worked extra hard to make these changes as seamless as possible.  

🖼 The Art team have been adding even more goodies into the game for you all to unlock and customise your brew spaces with. No spoilers! But they look really cool!

[h2]🍺 Buy your very own Auroch Digitale! 🍺[/h2] 

On Friday 22nd July, [url=https://www.bristol247.com/food-and-drink/news-food-and-drink/real-life-beer-to-accompany-bristol-made-beer-brewing-simulator/]Moor Beer launched our very own IRL beer into the world[/url], under the name of Auroch Digitale. Does that name ring a bell? 

You may remember us talking about [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1569200?emclan=103582791469729939&emgid=5326075212837065056]our partnership with them earlier this year[/url], and we're so excited that we've got a real-life beer you can taste whilst brewing your own in-game version!

But just how did this come about? 

🤔 Well, the idea of having an IRL beer come out to celebrate our game, was first a throwaway thought at the very beginning of our project. It seemed like it was one of those "[url=https://twitter.com/xeroxeroxero/status/1548376656749875201]would be cool, probably wouldn't happen[/url]" things.

🌾 But, thanks to our [url=https://twitter.com/writingmattbone]Designer, Matt[/url], homebrewing up the [url=https://twitter.com/AurochDigital/status/1415269443287060480]very first version of it way back when[/url], and coming up with the incredibly punny name, we actually had something we could pitch to our friends at [url=https://twitter.com/drinkmoorbeer]Moor Beer[/url].

🎨 And then it was down to our wonderful Art Team, where [url=https://twitter.com/elysiaart]Elysia[/url] came up with the initial ideas for the can, and the team (Joe, Chris, and Dan) set to work to make it the best it could be. When they were happy, they passed it over to Moor Beer's designer, [url=https://www.instagram.com/picbinben/]Ich Bin Ben[/url], to finish it off.

💗 Thus, at the risk of sounding like The Powerpuff Girls' intro, Auroch Digitale was born! Using its ultra hoppy powers, Auroch Digitale has dedicated its life to giving you a refreshing, real-life taste of one of our in-game recipes in Brewmaster, and what a fantastic collab it is! 😍

[h2]😸 Cutest pets in the biz 🐶[/h2]

[h2]🍻 What's been brewing this month? 🍻[/h2]
Hello friends old and new! Whether you’re joining us after seeing and playing Brewmaster for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1569200/view/3320854988536724510]first time at Next Fest[/url], or you’ve been with us [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1569200/view/3068616627213716843]since April 2021 when we announced the game[/url], or at some time in-between, we’re really glad you’re here. 

June has been pretty full-on for the team, starting with us creating a special version of the game for you to play for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfest]Next Fest[/url]. Whenever we create a “build” (the game you download and play), the development team here spends a bunch of time making sure it’s shipshape: squashing as many bugs as we can get to, squeezing in improvements we want you to see and, of course, making sure you get to hear that it’s available to play in the first place. 

But it’s been so so so worth that time. It sounds like you folks enjoyed the game, based on all the lovely messages we’ve had from you, and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1569200/view/3320856256821578026]we’re grateful to read your feedback[/url] on what you like, what can be improved, and so on. You’ve also found a few bugs we didn’t know about, which means we can polish those off ahead of launch too. 

Anything else? [i]Oh yes indeed.[/i]

🦠 We’ve been adding in the Contamination System, in which brews have the potential to become contaminated, just like they would in the real world. 

🏆 Achievements are now almost all in and we’re pretty proud of these, as they’re going to add another layer of challenge for those that want to demonstrate complete mastery of brewing. 

💡 There’s been a lot of work on tutorialisation too, both in terms of a more guided experience from Jeff that supports you as you take your first steps into homebrewing, as well as contextual hints that will help guide you on more complicated challenges. 

📝 Writing and translations are about 90% done (see the full list of currently confirmed languages on our store page), more cosmetic items than ever are in and waiting for you to decorate your brewing space, and the furniture system itself has also had some major improvements. 

Alright, what else have we got for you...

“Remember, remember [url=https://twitter.com/AurochDigital/status/1448273414632902657]the 23rd to the 29th of November[/url]” doesn’t quite have the same ring to it as the traditional version of the nursery rhyme, but you get the point – that’s when we’re giving you the first look at Brewmaster, and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1569200/view/3094529447403305901]it’s happening right now, but ending soon[/url]! 

Because the Public Alpha has again been our focus this month, the code team has mostly been making this area of the game as stable as possible before now and then. 
[list]
[*] [b]The art team[/b] has been hard at work on tidying up some of the liquid visuals and creating more furniture, some of which you’ll see in the Public Alpha. We’ve been continuing to “skin” big chunks of the user interface to give you a better idea of how the final thing will all look, plus working on the portraits for some of the characters you’ll meet in the game. We can’t wait for you to see how Jeff and the gang have turned out. 
[*] [b]Audio[/b] has completed its first pass of everything in the game and it’s sounding really good so far. Still some tweaks to go, but Brewmaster is now very pleasant to listen to on a decent set of headphones – let us know what you think of the birdsong 😉 
[*] [b]Our designers[/b] have been working hard too, with the majority of the meta systems now designed and waiting to be implemented. You won’t see these in the Public Alpha but, hey, if this test all goes well and you’d like us to run another one like it in the future, let us know, and we can think about getting a Public Beta organised for next year... 
[*] And finally, along with a load of work that goes on behind the scenes from our wonderful [b]marketing and community team[/b] at Auroch and Sold Out, we’ve also been gathering up a big set of questions we have for [b]you[/b] about the Public Alpha. What did you like about it, what did you not, what do you want more of, what do you want less of, and so on.  
[/list]
So if you’ve signed up for the Public Alpha - [url=http://bit.ly/Brewmastersignup]and if not, get on it quick[/url], [b]the closing date for sign-ups is 4pm GMT on Friday 26th Nov[/b] - keep those eyes peeled on your e-mails for your access code, and the survey we’ll be sending out where you can provide us your feedback, so we can make the best game that we can!

[b][h2]🎮What can I do in the Brewmaster Alpha?🎮[/h2][/b][list]
[*] Explore the kitchen and tasting room
[*] Follow a recipe as part of the alpha and try making a beer
[*] After making your beer you can simply experiment with the chemical simulation
[*] Test out a range of equipment including pots, pans, burners, mash tuns, barrels, and more
[*] Experiment with a range of ingredients
[*] Use the tasting sequence to see what kind of beer you have made
[/list][h3][i][u]📢 Please note: The Brewmaster Alpha is an early sample of the full game which is still in development. 📢[/u][/i][/h3]

[h2][b]❓ How is the alpha different to the full game ❓[/b][/h2]
The alpha is only a small snapshot of the game so we can get early feedback to help us improve it. As the game is still in active development you may well see things go wrong during your playthrough, or things might not work quite as nicely as we’d like - which is exactly why we do these kinds of playtests!

Some examples of things that will change before the game is out include (but are not limited to);
[list]
[*] The UI (the in-game menus), the alpha UI are placeholders currently.
[*] A more extensive tutorial will be included.
[*] This alpha contains only a fraction of the ingredients and equipment that will be in the full game.
[*] The final game will have story elements and a campaign
[*] Many other features, such as decorating the space, competitions, and creating beer labels are absent.[/list]
[b][h2]⌨️Where can I give feedback about Brewmaster?⌨️[/h2][/b]We will be sending a feedback survey round when the alpha ends. Please fill it in, it will be incredibly helpful to us!

[b][h2]🍻 Can my friend join the Brewmaster alpha? 🍻[/h2][/b]Sure thing, we are always on the look out for new Brewers. Get them to to [url=https://aurochdigital.us7.list-manage.com/subscribe?id=2491c97e85&u=80f9f24ab53812fcb7ca58b1c]sign up here[/url]. We will be sending out more alpha keys throughout the week. [b]Please note: Alpha signups close Friday 26th November.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40208531/adb678800c62059589610e3b94d0eec9a991374e.png[/img]
[b][h2]Tell me more about Brewmaster🍺[/h2][/b]Brew your perfect beer in this relaxing home brewing sim. Use a realistic chemistry simulation to brew all kinds of beers, from hoppy IPAs to creamy stouts. Customise your brewing space, create recipes and label your beer, unlock new equipment and enter competitions. Learn to brew, refine your craft and become a Brewmaster!

[h1] KNOWN ISSUES [/h1]

As this is an Alpha - there are some already known issues that we want players to be made aware of before launching the game:
[list][*]Interacting with the calendar takes a bit longer than we’d like at the moment - in the full game we’re aiming to make this area faster.
[*]Pressing “ESC” on the tasting sequence mat result in a crash
[*]VSync/Screen Tearing - Some users have reported this. The alpha does not have controls for this but you can manually change them through your graphic card’s control panel.
[*]In the full version, the recipe in the game will not be presented in the format you currently see.  We’re creating a system that will provide the same quality and depth of recipe, but in a more approachable format, with bite-sized steps.
[*]Some people have been struggling to find the tasting taps; they’re in the room opposite the kitchen counter. [/list]

If you experience any more issues that isn't covered above, visit us at [url=https://www.aurochdigital.com/blog/frequently-asked-questions-brewmaster] our FAQs [/url] to find out more 🍻

notes.title: 🍺 Brewers Club Monthly 🍺 Brewmaster Developer Update #5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40208531/61847dba1de9ddb25a9623cf3201bc79e128134b.png[/img]
[h2]Hi Brewers Club![/h2]
[h3]Welcome to the October issue of the Brewers club with your latest update on Brewmaster🍻
[/h3]
Make sure you are [url=https://aurochdigital.us7.list-manage.com/subscribe?id=2491c97e85&u=80f9f24ab53812fcb7ca58b1c]subscribed to our Brewers Club Newsletter[/url] to get these updates direct to your inbox. 

[h2]🍻 What have we got brewing? 🍻[/h2]
Right now the development team is heavily focused on the Public Alpha with a particular emphasis on fixing bugs and getting the “feel” of the game good. We know this is going to be much easier to do with your help, which is why we’re getting it into your hands as soon as possible, and why we can’t wait to hear your feedback ❤

[h3]🎧 Audio 🎧
[/h3]Part of that “feel” comes from audio, which is coming along at a grand old pace. For example, when you’re pouring, say, water into a container, the audio feedback helps you decide when to stop pouring, or if you’re pouring too vigorously. It’s also wonderfully cosy to just be in the brewing room listening to the ambience of the birds tweeting, while you think about what beer you’re going to make next. 

[h3]💻 Coding 💻
[/h3]The code team’s been smashing bugs that our intrepid QA team has been finding, but it’s also started throwing the game at more consoles and upgrading to the latest and greatest version of Unreal Engine 4, to see what works and what doesn’t after doing this - luckily, not a lot has gone wrong so far!

[h3] 📝 Design 📝
[/h3]What’s the design team been up to? Well, they’re working on the meta systems of the game: such as how you progress, what kind of tasks you’ll take on, and how this will all be presented. Our UI/UX team has been creating a kit to make the UI skinning process as smooth as possible, and so far it’s looking 😘👌

[h3]🎨 3D Artists 🎨
[/h3]Who have I missed out? Our 3D artists, of course! They’ve been making some of the final assets for the Public Alpha, as well as the brewing equipment that you’ll unlock during the game. And the furniture… my goodness the furniture they’ve made - absolutely gorgeous stuff.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40208531/80e78db71271ef0d1b2c80b9252122b249c379e5.png[/img]
[h2]The Brewmaster Alpha is happening 23rd - 29th Nov! [url=https://aurochdigital.us7.list-manage.com/subscribe?id=2491c97e85&u=80f9f24ab53812fcb7ca58b1c]Sign up here to make sure you receive a key[/url][/h2]
We're so hoppy to to invite you to the Brewmaster Closed Alpha! The Brewmaster alpha is a small sample of the game which will let you play around with some equipment and ingredients and brew a beer recipe from start to finish. We will be sending out a survey after the alpha to gather feedback and input from our community. 

[h3]🍺 What will the Brewmaster closed alpha include? 🍺[/h3]
The Brewmaster alpha is a small sample of the game which will let you play around with some equipment and ingredients and brew a beer recipe from start to finish. You’ll be able to:
[list][*] Explore the kitchen and tasting room
[*] Follow a recipe as part of the alpha and try making a beer
[*] After making your beer you can simply experiment with the chemical simulation
[*] Test out a range of equipment including pots, pans, burners, mash tuns, barrels, and more
[*] Experiment with a range of ingredients
[*] Use the tasting sequence to see what kind of beer you have made[/list]
[b]📢 Please note: The Brewmaster Alpha is an early sample of the full game which is still in development. 📢[/b]

[url=https://www.aurochdigital.com/blog/2021/10/6/brewmaster-alpha][list]
[*] [b]Find out more about the Brewmaster Alpha in our blog post[/b]
[/list][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40208531/0a901ce1f6c909d77a16f19441f1928a7ebb516f.png[/img]
[h2]🏠 Digital Tabletop Fest - the Tavern 🏠[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/tabletopfest]Steam's Digital Tabletop Fest: RPG Edition happened last week[/url]. This is an event we run in partnership with [url=https://twitter.com/Steam/status/1451583041000726528]Steam[/url] 🎲

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/tabletopfest]Digital Tabletop Fest[/url] was a multi-day celebration of tabletop gaming which ran from Oct 21 - 25, 2021. We hosted a main stage of amazing content with a focus on RPGs that you can catch up on soon. 

We ran a panel called The Tavern, all about alcohol and gaming. No RPG is complete without a tavern, so we of course had to look into games with beer! Including our very own devs from Brewmaster, joined by devs from Hundred Days, Viticulture, Talisman, and the founder of Hop Culture. 

All the streams from Digital Tabletop Fest will be available to rewatch soon. [url=https://twitter.com/AurochDigital]Keep an eye out on our socials to be the first to see them!
[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40208531/3b8b2470c81a2fdd636ddf9590b1969d01fb53d8.jpg[/img]
[h2]🛠️ EGX Panel | Can simulation games teach you how to do a real-life hobby or Job? 🛠️[/h2]
This was a panel we did for EGX 2021 featuring our Brewmaster developers. This panel goes into depth about how we've gone about making the game, from Art, to Marketing, to Programming.

The panellists chatted about the appeal and importance of the rising genre of simulation games. We also explored whether or not these games can actually teach you how to do their respective activity outside of the game.

Is there more value to be found in providing a digital recreation of a hobby or job to people who may not be able to do it otherwise?

[h2]Hi Brewers Club![/h2]
[h3]Welcome to the September issue of the Brewers club with your latest update on Brewmaster🍻
[/h3]
Make sure you are [url=https://aurochdigital.us7.list-manage.com/subscribe?id=2491c97e85&u=80f9f24ab53812fcb7ca58b1c]subscribed to our Brewers Club Newsletter[/url] to get these updates direct to your inbox.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40208531/d259963b9b936b7330dd0c8bd42e7ecead9c1706.jpg[/img]
[h2]🍻 What have we got brewing? 🍻[/h2]
[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Acrostic]Acrostics[/url], don’t you just love them? Let me tell you, we do. Properly good fun, but anyway...

How are we getting on with Brewmaster? Awesome, really just fantastic, as we’re heading towards an important milestone that we wish we could tell you about. Soon though, we can. 

Overall progress has been great, with lots of equipment and ingredients being added, and our snazzy in-world company branding being designed too. Oh and we should also point out that we’ve been doing lots of bug fixing and cleanup to make sure the brewing process is in fine form for whatever it is we can’t announce at the moment.

notes.title: 🍺 Brewers Club Monthly 🍺 Brewmaster Developer Update #3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40208531/61847dba1de9ddb25a9623cf3201bc79e128134b.png[/img]
[h2]Hi Brewers Club![/h2]
[h3]Welcome to the August issue, where we'll be giving you a Brewmaster Developer Update! 🍻
[/h3]
Don't forget, you can [url=https://aurochdigital.us7.list-manage.com/subscribe?id=2491c97e85&u=80f9f24ab53812fcb7ca58b1c]sign up to our Brewers Club Newsletter[/url] to get these updates direct to your inbox and be the first to hear about alphas and betas when we announce them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40208531/149c4825d5b0e2cc5cc451125f8905e8a8e747d2.gif[/img]
[h2]🍻 Working on core gameplay 🍻[/h2]
Is it the end of August [i]already[/i]? Time flies when you’re developing a video game about brewing beer, as the old saying goes.

We’ve been working on core gameplay the mostly this month, ensuring our first sets of objects are in and that you can use them to brew a beer; from getting out the equipment and ingredients from a cupboard, all the way to inspecting a finished brew. Mash tuns, stainless steel pans, fermentation containers, tubes, immersion coils, gas burners, ingredient packets, water taps… there’s a lot, and while there’s plenty of bugs right now, it’s all pretty much there.

Excitingly, our producer at Sold Out - [url=https://soldout.uk.com/]Brewmaster’s publisher[/url] - put Brewmaster’s chemical simulation to the test the other day and tried to make an IPA from a real life recipe book he had on his homebrewing bookshelf. And lo and behold, out popped an IPA! We’ll drink to that! 😊👍

But hey, why read about what’s been going on, when you can see what we’ve done instead 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40208531/c1a7d65c061b85cf3b4213eced1f12840a77cb75.png[/img]
[i][L-R; Programmer, Andres, Programmer, Jack, and Finance & Admin Assistant Danielle][/i]
[h2]🎉 Auroch visits a Beer Festival 🎉[/h2]
Brandon, Danielle, Andres, and Jack went to [url=https://bristolcraftbeerfestival.co.uk/]Bristol Craft Beer Festival[/url] on July 30th (yes that was technically last month but it was right at the end!) and tried a whole selection of beers; getting a lot of inspiration from talking to the brewers and other beer fans. 

Associate Designer, Brandon, said his favourite was Alternating Currants" by Brixton Brewery, a mixed berry sour. 🥫🍓 They have awesome can designs too! Our Finance and Admin Assistant, Danielle, is normally more of a cider drinker but she really enjoyed Jubel Beers as they were so fruity and tasty. She said if she had to pick a favourite it’d be the elderflower one. 🍎🍑🍐

One of our Brewmaster programmers, Andres, really enjoyed the New Bristol Salted Chocolate Bigger Cinder Toffee Stout. 🍫 He said it’s really easy to drink and full of amazing flavors. Jack is also a programmer and his favourite was an Arbor and Wiper And True collaboration, a sour beer blend. Both brewery's barrel aged a beer then blended them together. It was much smoother than many sours, but still with an edge to it and a lovely depth of flavour.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40208531/28908bdc1d3953a617184b8ed03cc95507a62549.png[/img]
[h2]🌾 Great grains! 🌾[/h2]
Enjoy a behind the scenes look at Brewmaster, [url=https://twitter.com/AurochDigital/status/1425431272688689153]with this look at our awesome grain pouring[/url]! Malt is one of the ingredients at the very heart of homebrewing, so we wanted to make sure grains look as pleasing on the eye as our liquid pouring system. [list][*][url=https://twitter.com/AurochDigital/status/1425431272688689153]Watch the video here ⭐[/url][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40208531/81ff4dc667f472b2b07467274bcd2ab33c379250.png[/img]
[h2]👀 Brew on the go 👀[/h2]
[url=https://twitter.com/AurochDigital/status/1430175683653869579]Here’s your first look at Brewmaster on Switch[/url]! Development of the game is going well, we were really excited to see what the game looks like in handheld mode. You’ll be able to brew your favourite beers on the go!

Don't be fooled though! We are still a way off completing development. But doesn't it look great?[list]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/AurochDigital/status/1430175683653869579]Watch the full video here! ⭐[/url][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40208531/0347d1154be58a15108907074e8514885cd148d2.png[/img]
[h2]🎤 Our producer chats with Shack News 🎤[/h2]
Our Creative Producer had a chat with [url=https://twitter.com/GregBurke85/status/1426338219126235140]Greg Burke[/url] over on ShackNews all about Brewmaster.  Want to find out what Superman vision is in a beer brewing simulator? [url=https://youtu.be/o0PB6-HFsUY]Find out in their chat here[/url]. Thank you so much to Shack News for having us![list]
[*][url=https://youtu.be/o0PB6-HFsUY]Listen (and watch) here! ⭐[/url][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40208531/ebf91fbb8b4270076a6e47a4b6c2ba49de3c687f.png[/img][h2]Hi Brewers Club[/h2]
[h3]Welcome to the June issue, where we'll be giving you a Brewmaster Developer Update! 🍻[/h3]

You can [url=https://aurochdigital.us7.list-manage.com/subscribe?id=2491c97e85&u=80f9f24ab53812fcb7ca58b1c][b]sign up to our Brewers Club Newsletter[/b][/url] to get these updates direct to your inbox and be the first to hear about alphas and betas when we announce them.

[h2]Brewmaster Developer Update [/h2]
The game has come a long way since we first showed it off in our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MCTqZtd705o]announcement trailer[/url]. The footage you've seen so far was an early concept visualisation and the game is looking better than ever now. We're excited to show you where it's at.

[h3]👀New look revealed👀[/h3]
If you [url=https://twitter.com/AurochDigital]follow us on Twitter[/url] you'll have seen our recent reveals of what Brewmaster looks like now. We are delighted to share with you [b][url=https://twitter.com/AurochDigital/status/1396083924493688836]a quick tour of our new brewing space[/url][/b], as well as a [b][url=https://twitter.com/AurochDigital/status/1403703381265317892]preview of our day/night cycle[/url][/b]. Check out these clips to see how Brewmaster is looking these days, and enjoy those cosy vibes, the ideal space to spend relaxing hours making your perfect beer 🍺

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40208531/53ce43accbad86fa323275e9afaa579bfebeed36.png[/img]

[h3]🧪Chemical Simulation🧪[/h3]
One of the biggest challenges in making our game is in the simulation of brewing chemistry. Brewmaster isn’t simply a case of hop + malt + yeast + water = beer. Rather it’s a complex system that tracks things like…
[list]
[*] How much of the specific flavours from hops go into a brew, based on when they’re added
[*] How much of the fermentable sugars are converted by the yeast into alcohol before it’s killed off
[*] How much of the water is lost to evaporation
[/list]… and so on.

We're spending a lot of time on this area of the game, as it’s at the very heart of the gameplay and will offer a huge variety of outcomes for players to experiment with.

There’s still a lot more work to be done, but currently you can use the systems we’ve built to brew something resembling a beer. As we’re yet to balance all the data the simulation is pulling from, we wouldn’t want to drink the beer we’ve managed to make, but give it time. Right now our team is able to look under-the-hood and see what the chemsim is doing using placeholder menus and graphs, which is a huge step forward in getting it feeling right.

[h3]⏰Time passing in Brewmaster⏰[/h3]
People have been asking us about how time works in the game; wondering whether they’ll need to wait two weeks of real time in order to reach the end of a fermentation, or even longer for a barrel-aged stout. As you’ll have seen from our [url=https://twitter.com/AurochDigital/status/1403703381265317892]day/night cycle video[/url], the game works in realtime but also allows you to speed up the passing of time, so you don't have to wait.

[h2] Matt brews Auroch Digit-ale 🍾[/h2]
Our Lead Game Designer for Brewmaster has been brewing his own beer at home. As we’re making a first-person homebrewing simulator we feel it's important that the team have plenty of hands-on experience. [url=https://twitter.com/AurochDigital/status/1400056634978836483/photo/1]He made an IPA and named it Auroch Digit-ale![/url] 

Here's what Matt had to say after his beer brewing experience:

[i]"Brewing my own beer was definitely useful when it comes to designing the game. Homebrewing as a hobby can appear intimidatingly complex from the outside - so it’s very important we get players over that barrier, and get them brewing beer as quickly as possible."

"It’s key that we show players that, at its core, the brewing process is quite straightforward. Then when they know the basics, we can show them just how much lies beyond - how much room for creative expression, experimentation, and mastery there is. As a hobby, it’s endlessly rewarding - it’s our job to convey that in the game."

"I crammed all the gear into my kitchen, scared the dog with the world’s largest stainless steel pan, and bought some obscenely bitter hops. At the end of it all, I had around 30 bottles of beer that was darker and a little maltier than I expected, and that could be anywhere between 3% and 6% ABV - but it was still recognisable as an IPA and, most importantly, was actually drinkable!"[/i]
